The working hours are from 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., which means that you will coordinate the shipping process tightly with your team especially in the afternoon and early evening. 
 The offer 
What to expect. - A gross hourly wage of €15; - A travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer; - Varied work with room for your own initiative; - A fully catered lunch on site every afternoon; - Free gym at the workplace to keep fit; - You will join an engaged, international team; - Good fringe benefits. 
 Job requirements 
What do you bring? - Experience with outbound duties such as order picking, packing and shipping; - Affinity for logistics and a hands-on mentality; - Command of the Dutch and/or English language; - You work accurately and have an eye for safety and quality; - Experience using an EPT is a plus. 
 About össur 
Össur is an international company that develops and distributes medical devices. This organization is all about innovation, precision and improving quality of life. Working at Össur means being part of a close-knit team that contributes daily to an important social goal: helping people get the right care faster. You will work in a dynamic, international environment where accuracy and cooperation are key.
